name: Reincock
source:
Reincock is a former human that swore complete loyalty to [url=/c97991]Camilla[/url], becoming her Apostle upon drinking her blood. Despite his girlish looks, he's actually a man dressed as a woman. He sometimes takes advantage of his feminine looks to seduce males he takes to Camilla. 

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Reincock]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
